name: wiki_search
description: Search the shared server Wiki by keywords across titles, tags, keywords and bodies. Pass synonyms and other phrasings of the query in also; articles matching more of them rank higher. Returns slugs, titles and excerpts, best match first. Search before answering from or writing to the Wiki.

also.description: Synonyms and alternate phrasings of the query, e.g. for refund: money back, reimbursement, return policy.
